roadmap.title: Meadows
roadmap.description: Start in the Meadows: gather wood and stone, build a first house with a lit campfire, and summon Eikthyr with 2 Deer Trophies. Solo and co-op boss kills, first deaths and the world-count milestone happen naturally here. Mods and cheat commands disable achievements; the devcommand yesiuseddevcommandsbutiwantmyachievementsanyway re-enables them.

roadmap.title: Black Forest
roadmap.description: Set up farming and beekeeping, move into the bronze and wood-iron tier, and defeat The Elder with 3 Ancient Seeds. The counting grinds for trees, food and building start stacking here.

roadmap.title: Swamp
roadmap.description: Push into the Swamp for iron: defeat Bonemass with 10 Withered Bones, use his Wishbone to dig up buried treasure, and raise taller buildings with wood-iron poles.

roadmap.title: Mountains
roadmap.description: Gear up against the cold, collect 3 Dragon Eggs, and defeat Moder.

roadmap.title: Plains
roadmap.description: Take on the Plains: defeat Yagluth with 5 Fuling Totems, farm crops and Cloudberries, and work the Ocean for Leviathans.

roadmap.title: Mistlands
roadmap.description: Unlock Mistlands crafting, build the exact 20-comfort setup, and defeat The Seeker Queen inside an Infested Citadel.

roadmap.title: Ashlands
roadmap.description: Enter the Ashlands: defeat the four minibosses (Brenna, Geirrhafa, Zil & Thungr, Lord Reto), assemble Dyrnwyn, and summon Fader with 3 Bells made from 9 Bell Fragments.

roadmap.title: Deep North
roadmap.description: Finish the campaign: gather 3 Malicious Blood from Jotun Invasions, defeat Kall Fimbulbringer through the Aesir Passage, and build at the highest altitude you can reach.

roadmap.title: Endgame cleanup
roadmap.description: Sweep up the cross-biome goals: world edges, sailing distances, every fish, every creature on Hard, all trophies, the full craft / cook / build / eat rosters, any remaining death causes, and the combo unlocks.

achievements.summary: Build a structure that reaches at least 49 m above the ground.

guide.context: The check is the piece's height above the ground, not the size of the building. Use `/pos` in chat to read your altitude.

steps.text: Build upward with strong supports such as wood-iron poles until a placed piece sits 49 m above the ground.
steps.note: Check your height with `/pos` while standing on the structure.

achievements.summary: Raise a structure at an altitude of 492 m or above.

guide.context: Start from the top of a tall @loc{Mountain} and keep building toward the maximum world height. Check the altitude with `/pos` and add more height if the achievement has not unlocked yet.

steps.text: Raise a supported structure from a high mountain summit until a placed piece sits at 492 m altitude.

achievements.summary: Die by all 16 tracked causes on one character.

guide.context: Only the killing blow counts (a creature that knocks you off a cliff still counts as a fall). Make it easy: remove armor, keep health at 25 by eating nothing, store valuables, and optionally switch @mechanic{Death Penalty} to Casual or None. Progress is visible with `/stats`.

collectibles.name: Enemy hit
collectibles.method: Let any hostile creature finish you off.
collectibles.note: On lower difficulties, hit it first so it fights back.

collectibles.name: Fall damage
collectibles.method: Jump from about 10 m with no armor and no food.

collectibles.name: Drowning
collectibles.method: Swim until your stamina empties, then stay in the water.

collectibles.name: Burning
collectibles.method: Stand in a lit @item{Campfire} without armor.
collectibles.note: 26 armor or more stops the flames from setting you alight.

collectibles.name: Freezing
collectibles.method: Wait outside in the cold without frost protection.
collectibles.note: Kills in about 25 seconds at 25 base health.

collectibles.name: Poison
collectibles.method: Let a @enemy{Blob} poison you, walk clear of other enemies and wait.

collectibles.name: Smoke
collectibles.method: Seal yourself in a small room (about 2x2) with a lit @item{Campfire} and stand in the smoke but not the flames.

collectibles.name: Tree
collectibles.method: Fell a tree and wait under its falling trunk.

collectibles.name: Stalactite
collectibles.method: Shoot a ceiling icicle from below with a bow and let it drop on you.

collectibles.name: Ballista
collectibles.method: Place a @item{Ballista} (10 Black Metal, 10 Yggdrasil Wood, 3 Mechanical Springs), load a bolt and stand in front of it.

collectibles.name: Boiling water
collectibles.method: Wade into the Ashlands ocean and remain in the water.
collectibles.note: Sail there in a @item{Drakkar}; other boats burn.

collectibles.name: Lava
collectibles.method: Walk into a lava lake.
collectibles.note: Death is instant; the tombstone rests on the lava surface and needs @item{Basalt Bombs} to recover.

collectibles.name: Catapult
collectibles.method: Place a @item{Catapult} (10 Flametal, 1 Charred Cogwheel, 20 Ashwood), then walk against a leg spike until it impales you.
collectibles.note: Only the legs count, not fired payloads.

collectibles.name: Obliterator
collectibles.method: Craft an @item{Obliterator} (8 Iron, 4 Copper, 1 Thunder Stone), put an item inside, climb onto the rod and pull the lever.

collectibles.name: Drawbridge
collectibles.method: Build a @item{Rustic Drawbridge} (2 Silver, 2 Wolf Trophy, 10 Corewood), stand on its outer half and operate it until it crushes you.

collectibles.name: World Edge
collectibles.method: Take a boat past the @loc{World Edge} with nothing in your inventory.
collectibles.note: A tombstone beyond the edge cannot be recovered.

achievements.description: Defeat all bosses on any difficulty.
achievements.summary: Defeat all 8 bosses on one character, on any difficulty.

guide.context: They are @enemy{Eikthyr} of the @loc{Meadows}, @enemy{The Elder} of the @loc{Black Forest}, @enemy{Bonemass} of the @loc{Swamp}, @enemy{Moder} of the @loc{Mountains}, @enemy{Yagluth} of the @loc{Plains}, @enemy{The Seeker Queen} of the @loc{Mistlands}, @enemy{Fader} of the @loc{Ashlands} and @enemy{Kall Fimbulbringer} of the @loc{Deep North}.

steps.text: Progress through every biome and defeat all eight bosses on the same character.

achievements.summary: Defeat all four minibosses: @enemy{Lord Reto}, @enemy{Zil & Thungr}, @enemy{Geirrhafa} and @enemy{Brenna}.

guide.context: Zil and Thungr count as two separate kills, so five are needed in total.

steps.text: Defeat @enemy{Brenna} in the @loc{Smouldering Tombs}.
Defeat @enemy{Geirrhafa} in the @loc{Howling Caverns}.
Defeat @enemy{Zil & Thungr} in the @loc{Sealed Tower}.
Defeat @enemy{Lord Reto} in his tomb.

achievements.summary: Enter your tenth world.

steps.text: Create and enter ten separate worlds; entering the tenth unlocks the achievement.

achievements.summary: Die for the first time.

steps.text: Take fatal damage and die once.

achievements.summary: Defeat @enemy{Eikthyr} in the @loc{Meadows}.

steps.text: Offer @item{2 Deer Trophies} at @enemy{Eikthyr's} altar and defeat him.

achievements.description: Defeat The Elder in the Black Forest.
achievements.summary: Defeat the @loc{Black Forest} boss, @enemy{The Elder}.

steps.text: Burn @item{3 Ancient Seeds} on @enemy{The Elder's} altar and defeat him.

achievements.summary: Defeat @enemy{Bonemass} in the @loc{Swamp}.

steps.text: Sacrifice @item{10 Withered Bones} at @enemy{Bonemass's} altar and defeat him.

achievements.summary: Defeat @enemy{Moder} in the @loc{Mountains}.

steps.text: Place @item{3 Dragon Eggs} on @enemy{Moder's} altar and defeat her.

achievements.summary: Defeat @enemy{Yagluth} in the @loc{Plains}.

steps.text: Offer @item{5 Fuling Totems} at @enemy{Yagluth's} altar and defeat him.

achievements.description: Defeat The Seeker Queen in the Mistlands.
achievements.summary: Defeat @enemy{The Seeker Queen} in the @loc{Mistlands}, inside an @loc{Infested Citadel}.

steps.text: Enter the citadel with a @item{Sealbreaker} and defeat The Queen.
steps.note: The first fight needs no offering.

achievements.summary: Defeat @enemy{Fader} in the @loc{Ashlands}.

steps.text: Collect @item{9 Bell Fragments} from @loc{Charred Fortresses} and combine every three at a @loc{Black Forge} into a @item{Bell}.
Place the three @item{Bells} on the altar at the @loc{Emerald Flame} and defeat Fader.

achievements.description: Defeat Kall Fimbulbringer in the Deep North.
achievements.summary: Defeat @enemy{Kall Fimbulbringer} through the @loc{Aesir Passage} in the @loc{Deep North}.

steps.text: Destroy the Malicious Ice at the bottom of @loc{Mörkhalla}, clear the @loc{Jotun Invasion} it starts and take the @item{Malicious Blood}; repeat until you hold 3.
Bring the @item{3 Malicious Blood} into the @loc{Aesir Passage}, offer it at @enemy{Kall Fimbulbringer's} altar and defeat him.

achievements.summary: Die to the lightning strike of an activated @item{Obliterator}.

guide.context: Buy 1 @item{Thunder Stone} from @npc{Haldor} to unlock the recipe. Haldor appears in the @loc{Black Forest} about 1500 m from the spawn point, shown as a bag icon on the map.

steps.text: Craft an @item{Obliterator} from 8 Iron, 4 Copper and 1 Thunder Stone and place it down.
Put any item inside, stand right next to it and pull the lever.
steps.note: Repeat the strike until the lightning kills you.

achievements.description: Get killed by a falling tree.
achievements.summary: Get killed by a falling tree.

steps.text: Chop down a tree and stand in the path of its falling trunk.
steps.note: The tree itself must land the killing blow, so keep other enemies away.

achievements.description: Get killed by every kind of tree.
achievements.summary: Get killed by all 10 tree variants.

guide.context: The two Deep North variants both carry the in-game name @item{Timber Tree}; die to each visually distinct one. Only the tree's own hit counts, so clear nearby enemies before felling.

collectibles.name: Beech
collectibles.method: Fell the tree with an axe and stand under the falling trunk.

collectibles.name: Birch
collectibles.method: Fell the tree and let the trunk crush you.

collectibles.name: Oak
collectibles.method: Fell the tree and let the trunk crush you.

collectibles.name: Fir
collectibles.method: Fell the tree and let the trunk crush you.

collectibles.name: Pine
collectibles.method: Fell the tree and let the trunk crush you.

collectibles.name: Ancient Tree
collectibles.method: Fell the large swamp tree and let its trunk crush you.

collectibles.name: Yggdrasil Shoot
collectibles.method: Fell the shoot and let its trunk crush you.

collectibles.name: Scorched Tree
collectibles.method: Fell the burned tree and let its trunk crush you.

collectibles.name: Snow Fir
collectibles.method: Fell it and let the trunk crush you.

collectibles.name: Snow Pine
collectibles.method: Fell it and let the trunk crush you.

achievements.summary: Cut down 500 trees.

steps.text: Chop down trees until the total reaches 500.
steps.note: Your best axe makes the work quicker.

achievements.summary: Cook 100 dishes.

guide.context: Several @item{Cooking Stations} can be placed over one campfire to cook multiple items at once.

steps.text: Cook food regularly and batch the work over a single fire until 100 dishes are done.

achievements.summary: Harvest 500 crops.

guide.context: Replanted and regrown crops count toward the total.

steps.text: Farm continuously and harvest 500 crops.

achievements.summary: Pick 250 berries and 250 mushrooms.

guide.context: For berries: @item{Cloudberries}, @item{Blueberries}, @item{Lingonberries}, @item{Raspberries} and the @item{Vineberry Cluster}. For mushrooms: @item{Magecap}, @item{Jotun Puffs}, @item{Smoke Puff}, @item{Mushroom} and @item{Yellow Mushroom}.

steps.text: Pick every berry and mushroom you pass until both totals reach 250.
steps.note: The @loc{Plains} is packed with @item{Cloudberries}, and @item{Magecap} and @item{Jotun Puffs} can be planted and harvested on a farm.

achievements.summary: Kill one of every creature type.

guide.context: Passive animals count. To register the creatures you summon yourself, including @enemy{Summoned Troll}, @enemy{Summoned Twitcher}, @enemy{Skelett}, @enemy{Mistile} and @enemy{Root}, turn on friendly fire before killing them.

steps.text: Fight through every biome and kill one of each creature type, checking progress with `/stats`.
Turn on friendly fire and kill each summon type you are still missing.

achievements.description: Kill every kind of creature on hard difficulty.
achievements.summary: Kill one of every creature type on @mechanic{Hard} difficulty.

guide.context: Only kills made on the @mechanic{Hard} or @mechanic{Very Hard} preset count. Do this and The Hunter in one Hard playthrough so the work is done only once.

steps.text: Set the world to @mechanic{Hard} and kill one of each creature type, including passives and your own summons with friendly fire on.

achievements.summary: Collect one trophy from every creature that drops one.

guide.context: Boss and miniboss trophies always drop; ordinary creatures drop theirs at rates as low as 5%, and Resource Rate does not affect trophies. @enemy{Serpent} trophies sink, so kill Serpents near the shore or drag them in with an @item{Abyssal Harpoon}.

steps.text: Defeat every boss and miniboss for their guaranteed trophies.
Farm each ordinary creature until its low-chance trophy drops.

achievements.summary: Build a house with at least 6 floor pieces, 8 walls, 4 roof pieces, 1 furniture piece, 1 light source and 1 storage piece inside one loaded zone.

guide.context: Pieces placed in other zones do not count toward the totals.

steps.text: Place the pieces inside one loaded zone: for example 6 floor pieces, 8 wall pieces, 4 roof pieces, a bed, a light and a chest.

achievements.summary: Build 40 floor pieces, 40 walls, 20 roofs, 10 buildings, 10 architecture, 10 furniture, 5 light and 5 decor pieces inside one loaded zone.

guide.context: Every piece must register inside the same loaded zone.

steps.text: Fit every required piece into one loaded zone: 10 buildings, 10 architecture pieces, 10 furniture, 20 roofs, 40 walls, 40 floors, 5 light sources and 5 decor pieces.
steps.note: A large base built in one area naturally fills these categories.

achievements.summary: Harvest 500 honey.

guide.context: A @item{Beehive} yields roughly 1 @item{Honey} per 20 minutes, with a stockpile cap of 4. Wild hives in @loc{Abandoned Houses} and around the @loc{Swamp} break into a @item{Queen Bee} used to build more hives.

steps.text: Build several beehives early and collect every honey they store until the total reaches 500.

achievements.displayName: No Adventuring On an Empty Stomach
achievements.summary: Eat 500 items of food.

guide.context: Up to three food types can be active at once, and the same type cannot be eaten again until it is partially digested.

steps.text: Keep food buffs running during normal play and eat 500 items in total.

achievements.description: Defeat all bosses on normal difficulty or higher.
achievements.summary: Defeat all 8 bosses on normal difficulty or higher.

guide.context: The Normal, Hard and Very Hard presets all count.

steps.text: Set the world's combat difficulty to @mechanic{Normal} or higher and defeat all eight bosses on the same character.

achievements.description: Defeat all bosses on hard difficulty.
achievements.summary: Defeat every one of the 8 bosses while the world is on hard difficulty.

guide.context: Only the @mechanic{Hard} and @mechanic{Very Hard} presets count. Select @mechanic{Hard}, then change only Passive Enemies, No Build Cost, Portals, Resource Rate and Death Penalty; the world must still show @mechanic{Hard+} next to its name, not Custom Modifiers.

steps.text: Set the world to the @mechanic{Hard} preset and defeat all eight bosses.
steps.note: A second, well-equipped character can carry the run if your main world is not on Hard.

achievements.summary: Survive 30 consecutive days without dying.

guide.context: Sleeping advances the day count and skips dangerous nights. Finish the death achievements before starting this, or after it is done.

steps.text: Stay safe in a well-defended base for 30 in-game days in a row and sleep often to skip night.

achievements.summary: Reach a comfort level of 20.

guide.context: Only the best piece in each comfort category counts, and everything must be within 10 m. A Mistlands-ready setup totalling exactly 20: a @item{Hearth}, a @item{Dragon Bed}, a @item{Bearskin Rug}, a @item{Blue Jute Curtain}, a @item{Throne}, a @item{Long Heavy Table}, one plant, one stand, a lit @item{Hot Tub} and a @item{Dvergr Lantern Pole}.

steps.text: Build the comfort pieces together in one room, light the fire and hot tub, then rest inside.

achievements.description: Sail over the edge of the world.
achievements.summary: Sail over the @loc{World Edge}.

guide.context: The edge sits about 10,350 m from the world centre and the currents there are strong.

steps.text: Sail past the @loc{World Edge} and let the current take the boat over.
steps.note: Travel with an empty inventory; a tombstone beyond the edge cannot be recovered.

achievements.summary: Dig up and open 10 buried treasure chests.

guide.context: The @item{Wishbone} dropped by @enemy{Bonemass} pings when buried treasure is nearby.

steps.text: Equip the @item{Wishbone} and dig where it pings until you have opened 10 buried chests.

achievements.summary: Awaken a @enemy{Leviathan} and let it sink.

guide.context: Leviathans never return once they submerge. Each hit on an @item{Abyssal Barnacle} has a 10% chance to disturb one; 20 seconds after the first disturbance it starts sinking for good.

steps.text: Find a @enemy{Leviathan} in the @loc{Ocean} and mine its @item{Abyssal Barnacles} until it shakes and begins to sink.
Stay near its centre until it is fully underwater.
steps.note: Back up the world save first if you want a safety net.

achievements.summary: Catch one of all 12 kinds of fish.

guide.context: Fish only count when you reel them in on a @item{Fishing Rod}; the line snaps beyond about 30 m. Basic bait is sold by @npc{Haldor} (10 coins per 20); advanced baits are crafted at a @item{Food Preparation Table} from 20 basic bait plus the matching trophy.

collectibles.name: Perch
collectibles.method: Fish with @item{Fishing Bait} and reel it in.

collectibles.name: Pike
collectibles.method: Fish with @item{Fishing Bait} or @item{Cold Fishing Bait} and reel it in.

collectibles.name: Tuna
collectibles.method: Fish with @item{Heavy Fishing Bait}, made from a @item{Serpent Trophy}, and reel it in.
collectibles.note: Moves over a very wide range.

collectibles.name: Trollfish
collectibles.method: Fish with @item{Mossy Fishing Bait}, made from a @item{Troll Trophy}, and reel it in.

collectibles.name: Giant Herring
collectibles.method: Fish with @item{Sticky Fishing Bait}, made from an @item{Abomination Trophy}, and reel it in.

collectibles.name: Tetra
collectibles.method: Fish with @item{Cold Fishing Bait}, made from a @item{Fenring Trophy}, and reel it in.
collectibles.note: Frost Cave lakes are rare; Tetra spawns reliably at any lake you find.

collectibles.name: Grouper
collectibles.method: Fish with @item{Stingy Fishing Bait}, made from a @item{Fuling Trophy}, and reel it in.

collectibles.name: Anglerfish
collectibles.method: Fish with @item{Misty Fishing Bait}, made from a @item{Lox Trophy}, and reel it in.

collectibles.name: Pufferfish
collectibles.method: Fish with @item{Misty Fishing Bait}, made from a @item{Lox Trophy}, and reel it in.

collectibles.name: Coral Cod
collectibles.method: Fish with @item{Heavy Fishing Bait}, made from a @item{Serpent Trophy}, and reel it in.

collectibles.name: Magmafish
collectibles.method: Fish with @item{Hot Fishing Bait}, made from a @item{Charred Warrior Trophy}, and reel it in.

collectibles.name: Northern Salmon
collectibles.method: Fish with @item{Frosty Fishing Bait}, made from a @item{Drake Trophy}, and reel it in.

achievements.description: Travel far in all four directions.
achievements.summary: Reach more than 10,350 m from the world centre in all four directions.

guide.context: The World Edge lies about 150 m past those points near the cardinal directions.

steps.text: Travel past the 10,350 m mark out to the east, west, north and south edges of the world.
steps.note: A @item{Longship} is the fastest boat for the trip, and the four directions can be done in any order. Do this together with The Pathfinder.

achievements.description: Travel far in all four directions, without using a map.
achievements.summary: Reach more than 10,350 m from the world centre in all four directions with @mechanic{No Map} active.

guide.context: @mechanic{No Map} hides the map and the minimap. You can reach each edge first with the map on, then switch @mechanic{No Map} on at the edge and move a little past the 10,350 m line to register the direction.

steps.text: Turn on the @mechanic{No Map} world modifier and travel past the 10,350 m mark north, south, east and west while it stays active.

achievements.summary: Assemble @item{Dyrnwyn}.

guide.context: The hilt fragment comes from @enemy{Lord Reto}; runestones in @loc{Putrid Holes} reveal the mysterious locations holding the blade and tip fragments. The fragments are not renewable, so only one sword can be made.

steps.text: Take the @item{Dyrnwyn Hilt Fragment} dropped by @enemy{Lord Reto}, then follow the @loc{Putrid Hole} runestones to the Blade and Tip Fragments.
Assemble @item{Dyrnwyn} at a @loc{Black Forge} upgraded to level 4, using 20 @item{Flametal} and 1 @item{Bloodstone}.

achievements.summary: Craft one of every weapon.

guide.context: Crafting every item for The Artisan covers this automatically, so work on both achievements together.

steps.text: Craft one weapon of every kind across all tiers, from early stone and flint weapons to the newest materials.

achievements.summary: Cook one of every dish.

guide.context: Dishes come from the @item{Cooking Station}, @item{Cauldron}, @item{Stone Oven}, @item{Food Preparation Table} and @item{Iron Cooking Station}. Save this for late game when every station and ingredient is available.

steps.text: Cook one of every dish the game offers, including station-specific recipes you may have skipped.

achievements.summary: Craft one of every item.

guide.context: Includes every weapon (The Blacksmith's list) and everything else the crafting menus offer. Leave it until late game, when every station and material is on hand.

steps.text: Craft one of every item across the crafting stations, working through the menus biome by biome.

achievements.description: Eat every kind of edible item.
achievements.summary: Eat one of every edible item.

guide.context: The list covers raw picks (berries, mushrooms), meats, fish and every cooked dish.

steps.text: Eat one of every food item, including the raw berries and mushrooms you might otherwise skip.

achievements.summary: Build one of every piece in the Hammer's build menu.

guide.context: Dismantling is fine: build the piece to register it, then reclaim the materials.

steps.text: Build one of every building piece in the Hammer menu, including decorative pieces, then dismantle what you no longer need.
steps.note: Also repair any item at a workbench at least once.

achievements.description: Embody the spirits of the Viking, Hunter, Artisan, Master Chef, Carpenter and the Explorer.
achievements.summary: Complete The Hunter, The Viking, The Master Chef, The Gourmet, The Artisan, The Explorer and The Carpenter.

guide.context: This unlocks automatically once every listed achievement is done.

steps.text: Finish the prerequisite achievements; this then unlocks on its own.

achievements.description: Embody the spirits of the Toughest Viking, Master Hunter, Survivor and Pathfinder.
achievements.summary: Complete The Master Hunter, The Toughest Viking, The Pathfinder and The Survivor.

guide.context: This unlocks automatically once every listed achievement is done.

steps.text: Finish the four prerequisite achievements; this then unlocks on its own.

achievements.description: Kill a boss together with a friend.
achievements.summary: Defeat one boss with at least one other player who damages it.

guide.context: Both players must use different character names and both must damage the boss. The same kill cannot count for both this and Lone Wolf.

steps.text: Fight a boss together with a friend and make sure you both damage it before it dies.

achievements.description: Kill a boss all by yourself.
achievements.summary: Defeat one boss as the only player who deals it damage.

guide.context: The same kill cannot count for both this and Stronger Together.

steps.text: Defeat any boss while you are the only player damaging it.

achievements.summary: Reel in a four-star fish.

guide.context: Fish spawn at quality 1 to 5 and four-star fish are rare (about 0.64% of spawns, lower in the @loc{Ashlands} and @loc{Deep North}). The catch only counts if you reel it in. A @item{Fishing Hat} (+20 Fishing) and stamina meads make the reel manageable.

steps.text: Bring strong bait, a @item{Fishing Hat}, high Fishing skill and stamina meads, then fully reel in the line when a four-star fish bites.
If a four-star catch does not register, throw that fish back into a small pond and reel it in there.

achievements.summary: Place 500 building pieces.

steps.text: Build until you have placed 500 pieces; ordinary base building counts toward the total.

achievements.description: Sail far enough to circle the world twice.
achievements.summary: Sail a cumulative 131 km 946 m.

guide.context: Distance counts whether you steer or ride as a passenger.

steps.text: Keep sailing until the total distance passes 131 km 946 m.
steps.note: This is the longest single grind in the game; save it for last.

achievements.description: Sail far enough to circle the world, while manning the helm.
achievements.summary: Sail a cumulative 65 km 973 m while manning the helm.

guide.context: Only distance sailed while you control the ship counts.

steps.text: Take the helm and keep sailing; the distance accumulates across sessions.
steps.note: Leave this for the end of the run to avoid a dedicated grind.
